ios.desc:
NimbusWx is a spot forecasting tool that visualizes the numeric model data from the weather computers used by industry experts. It's powered by the incredibly popular website SpotWx, which is used by professionals all over North America and the world. 

***New in Version 1.2: Create your own custom AI weather forecaster - powered by chatGPT

The difference between NimbusWx and other weather products is that we've lifted the veil on forecasts by giving you access to the raw weather data. That raw data is normally inaccessible because it requires special desktop software to open and interpret, we take that data and turn it into a human friendly visual format so you can make forecasts like a pro.  

NimbusWx features include: 

- Customizable AI weather forecaster. You can control what type of weather data you want to know about, and how the forecaster behaves.

- Select any coordinates on Earth. 

- View and compare multiple weather models for your coordinates. 

- Save your favourite places for fast viewing. 

- See the models simulated altitude, and spatial / temporal resolution. 

- View advanced weather metrics. 

Models currently available on the mobile version:

- GFS (Global Forecast System)
- RDPS (Regional Deterministic Prediction System)
- HRDPS Continental (High Resolution Deterministic Prediction System)
- HRDPS 1km West (High Resolution Deterministic Prediction System)
- GDPS (Global Deterministic Prediction System)
- NAM (North American Mesoscale Model)
- HRRR (High-Resolution Rapid Refresh)
- RAP (Rapid Refresh)

quotes.text:
This is for the proper weather nerds. I've taken the numeric weather models from the website SpotWx and combined the weather data with chatGPT to get any character to tell me the weather.

It can also tell you useful things like if the skiing or kite surfing conditions are good, but that's not as fun.

Has AI gone too far?
